decisions.reason: As a multi-model handle family in the firm's core architectural hardware business that remained on the website through 2024, it carries enough investment and strategic fit for management to continue backing it despite limited visible performance evidence.
Its dedicated 2024 product page signals a more public commitment and suggests relevance to the firm's barrier-free and system-solution direction, making management likely to persist with it.

Although it appears to have less visible differentiation than some other launches, it is still a core door-handle line and sunk development and range costs make withdrawal within a year less likely than continuation.

This collection has strong public visibility, direct design-award recognition, and clear fit with the firm's design-led coordinated product-family strategy, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on the market.
